race.title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap
race.verdict: REAL JACK wasted no time getting back on track when runner-up at Musselburgh last time and, having gone close on his previous start at this venue, he could be ready to open his account. Forever Twenty has run well over this C&D on 2 of her last 3 outings and is feared most, with Liquid Cooled another to consider. REAL JACK FOREVER TWENTY LIQUID COOLED (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Forever Twenty (3/1), Real Jack (9/2), Masai Angel (13/2), Yesnia (7/1), Archangel Josepi (8/1), Irish Incentive (12/1), Twilight Dawn (12/1), Liquid Cooled (12/1), Container Express (16/1), Saxon Prince (16/1), Midnight Serenade (20/1), Danrana (25/1), Uncertainty (33/1), Scheffler (50/1)
